headline: Historical Commission to review historic house plaque applications, the Lanesville/Lane's Cove National Registry District application, and preservation restriction requests.
summary: The commission will discuss historic house plaques, the demolition delay ordinance, preservation restriction applications, and the Lanesville/Lane's Cove National Registry District nomination. It will also review updates on preservation awards, CPC funding requests, and the historic buildings register.
items: Demolition delay ordinance: creating description for website and list of historical contractors

Historic house plaques: review of 73 plaques on interactive map, voted applications for 5 Wiley St, 28 Friend St, 11 Pirates Lane, 34-36 Summer St, 1206 Washington St, and possible new application for 150 Leonard St, Annisquam
2026 MACRIS updates on recent work and submissions
Tercentenary markers QR code project with high school students
2027 Preservation Awards: nominee list, event location and filming plans, RNAC newsletter publicity
CPC update on 10 applicants requesting historic funding, including Burnham Railways letter and Lanesville National Register Survey question
Register of Historic Buildings: correcting build-year records for 126 Lanesville and 3,230 Gloucester houses
Rocky Neck Cultural Center Historic Art Trail: possible addition of historic sites and plaques
Preservation restrictions applicants: William Haskell House at 11 Lincoln St and Tucker House-Hayden Cottage at 64R Eastern Point Blvd
Lanesville/Lane's Cove National Registry District application: focus area and funding update
Certified Local Government status: inquiry about overdue 2023, 2024, 2025 annual reports
Calendar update on Sept 11-13 Bayliss ACROPOLIS weekend program
location: Rose Baker Senior Center, 2nd floor conference room, 6 Manuel F. Lewis Street, Gloucester, MA 01930
